description: Repairs r-ado-1b/fields-refresh-ddl: ALTER TABLE W failed because the probe's own recordsets held W, so no DDL was applied and the later Fields.Item("X") answers carry no meaning. On a read-write copy of r-ado-1b-main, with only a client static read-only recordset open when the DDL runs: each recordset of SELECT * FROM W ORDER BY ID reads Fields.Count, calls Fields.Refresh and reads Count; ALTER TABLE W ADD COLUMN X TEXT(10) executes on the Connection with Connection.Errors read and cleared right after; each retained Fields collection reads Count, is Refreshed (Errors after) and reads Count; each recordset then calls Requery and reads Count; Fields.Item("X") Name is read; a new recordset of the same SELECT reads Count and Fields.Item("X"). Asks whether the ALTER succeeds, and whether Refresh, Requery, reopening or neither picks up the new column.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-wire-ado probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
